evidence: Static review of the frozen bytes; I did not build or run the agent image. (1) task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). Its only COPY steps are lines 14-15 (`COPY instructions/ /instructions/`, `COPY assets/ /assets/`); nothing copies solution/ or tests/. Lines 17-23 create /app, git-init it and commit only `.gitkeep`, so /app starts with no starter, skeleton or partial UI. (2) The build context task/environment/ contains exactly Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and six instruction notes; no hidden or extra files. (3) assets/seed_data.json:1-4 is `{"snippets": [], "note": ...}` (149 bytes): no schema, route list, sample source or implementation. (4) The six notes describe product behaviour in prose only; policy.md:3 explicitly leaves layout, labels, routes and database schema to the builder, and integration.md:7 states the seed has no starter implementation. They contain no code, selectors, schema or route list beyond the required GET /api/health and / (integration.md:3). (5) No rubric reproduction: an 8-word shingle comparison of instruction.md + all notes + seed against every tests judge.toml, prompt.md and app_context.md found 0 shared 8-word sequences; none of the criterion ids collected from the judge.toml files and none of the words rubric/judge/criterion/criteria/gate/likert/reward/score/oracle/golden/solution//tests/cw_ occur in the public text. (6) The golden lives only in task/solution/ and is installed by solution/solve.sh:39 at Oracle time; tests/ are copied only into the separate verifier image (tests/Dockerfile:43, task.toml:28 environment_mode = "separate"). Broken-app probe: an agent that builds nothing leaves /app with only .gitkeep, so there is no finished copy to submit; the evidence index records nop reward 0, but on an EARLIER candidate (ZIP eda58464), not these bytes, so that is supporting context rather than a measurement here. Conforming-alternative probe: this row places no constraint on the agent's implementation, so no conforming app can fail because of it. Not checked: an actual image build/inspection of /app, /instructions and /assets, and whether the solution is reachable over the public network from outside this repository (network_mode public is the mandated profile and is not a finding).
